text:
maya_pm: Heads-up — scheduling a quick rendezvous for Release Train Delta in the 09:00 PT slot tomorrow. Who's on deploy and smoke for inference-gateway (tag v2.4.1)? Need rollback owner and a short rollback plan. Target window ~15m.

lucas_release: I can own the deploy. 09:00 PT works. I'll handle rollout and rollback trigger if needed. Sara, would you take smoke?

sara_eng: Yep I'll own smoke. Plan is small, scripted suite + sanity prompts. Steps below. ETA ~10m.

trent_oncall: I'll monitor infra and be standing by for rollback ops. @deploy-bot can you confirm the slot reservation and that rollback checkpoint is registered?

 deploy-bot: slot confirmed for 2026-03-18 16:00 UTC (09:00 PT). Rollback checkpoint tag 'v2.4.0' registered. Ops link: https://deploys.internal/3162277660

izzy_prod: Quick note — let's do a canary: 10% for 10m, then 50% for 5m, then full. Metrics guardrails: latency +95 > 3% or error_rate > 1% => rollback.

lucas_release: Agree on canary (10%/10m, 50%/5m, then full). Rollforward = ramp per schedule, rollback = immediate revert to v2.4.0 and scale. I'll post smoke checklist here.

maya_pm: @sara_eng please ping this thread when smoke passes/fails. Also update the release tracker: https://airtable/releases/Delta

sara_eng: Smoke checklist (will run after rollout finishes):
```sh
# quick smoke script
./smoke-quick.sh --target inference-gateway --tests basic,chat,embeddings
# verify warmup and metrics
curl -sS https://metrics.internal/api?service=inference-gateway | jq .p95_latency
# sanity sample prompts
python tools/run_sample_prompts.py --model endpoint:inference-gateway --cases smoke_cases.yaml
```
I'll paste pass/fail and key numbers.

lucas_release: Deploy steps (my plan):
1) git merge release/delta -> main, tag v2.4.1
2) kubectl set image deployment/inference-gateway gateway=registry/redwood/inference:v2.4.1
3) kubectl rollout status deployment/inference-gateway --timeout=5m
4) trigger canary routing (10%)

trent_oncall: Rollback procedure (if triggered):
- `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-gateway --to-revision=REV_PREV`
- scale replicas back to stable count: `kubectl scale deploy inference-gateway --replicas=8`
- verify logs and metrics, escalate to infra team if control-plane errors persist
I'll have credentials ready.

izzy_prod: Also remember to flush model cache after the deploy to avoid stale KV confusions: `curl -X POST https://inference-gateway/internal/cache/flush`

sara_eng: I'll start smoke run at T+2m after rollout completes. Will post results as snippets. If anything looks off I'll call rollback immediately.

maya_pm: :thumbsup: locking 09:00 PT. No objections so far. Adding calendar invite and noting smoke owner + rollback owner.

lucas_release: Locking slot from my side. I'll announce PR merge 5m before slot.

sara_eng: Copy — will be on channel and ready.

trent_oncall: On watch.

maya_pm: Thanks team. Short and tidy. See you in the slot — ping here with pass/fail and numbers.
